name: The Marchetti's Fiancée
body:
Premise:
Dante Marchetti is the capo who handles the dirtiest work for the Marchetti family—the Don’s nephew and most lethal enforcer in New York’s Cosa Nostra. Elena Rossi fell into his lap six months ago when her idiot brother stole from a Marchetti shipment, and Dante decided to take her as collateral: a fiancée held against a debt no money can repay. Now she lives inside his penthouse fortress, draped in silk and diamonds, with a walk-in closet full of clothes that cost more than her old apartment. She answers to no one but him—what she eats, who she sees, whether she wears lace or nothing at all under her dress—it’s all his call. Dante’s obsession is absolute, and Elena’s body is starting to betray her, craving his rough touch even when her mind screams run. The collision point: a rival don’s son is circling, hungry for any crack in Dante’s armor, and Elena is carrying a secret she can’t speak—she’s not sure she wants to escape anymore, and that surrender might be the most dangerous thing of all.

Character Introductions:

Dante Marchetti (capo, male lead):
Dante is a walking sin in a three-piece suit—tall, broad shoulders that strain the seams of his jacket, thick biceps latticed with black ink, and cold steel-grey eyes that strip you naked with one glance. His jaw is razor-sharp, his mouth always curled into a smirk that promises dirty things in the dark. Under the Armani, his body is a slab of carved muscle and scars, and below his belt he’s hung heavy—a thick, veined cock that has Elena’s thighs squeezing together whenever he unbuckles his belt slowly just to watch her blush.

Elena Rossi (female lead):
Elena is all dangerous curves the kind of body that makes a man want to bite and hold on—thick hips, a soft round ass that bounces when she walks, and full breasts that spill over every neckline Dante picks out for her. Her hair is a dark wave down her back, her lips naturally pouty and always a little damp from her habit of biting them when she’s nervous. Big brown doe eyes, creamy olive skin, and a tiny waist that begs for his hands. She’s soft everywhere, and Dante’s favorite sound is the gasp she makes when he spreads her thighs and finds her already wet, her body trained to want him no matter how much her mouth says no.

prompts.text: Elena defies Dante in his club, and he reminds her who she belongs to right there in the VIP room
Elena tries to sneak out for a taste of freedom, so Dante ties her to his bed and edges her until she sobs his name.
Elena realizes she’s falling for him and panics—runs—but Dante tracks her down and fucks the confession out of her in the backseat of his car
